title: Prefix a themed wagon's produced URNs with the wagon theme

values: a wagon declares a theme and produces at least one artifact, contract, or telemetry identity URN
facts.note: Applicability fact, not a violation: an observer (the static validator) must read every wagon's declared theme and the URNs of all identities it produces, wherever those are declared (no file kind or location restriction). Comparing each produced URN's leading theme segment with the theme is the compliance check performed after the rule applies; a mismatched prefix is the violation outcome, not a precondition. Applies to all themed wagons, including pre-existing ones, regardless of which fields the current change touched.

fires: Authoring, editing, validating, or reviewing any wagon that declares a theme and produces artifacts, contracts, or telemetry identities, wherever its produced identities are declared, even if the current edit touched neither the theme nor the URNs.
Adding a produced artifact, contract, or telemetry URN to a themed wagon.
Changing a wagon's declared theme while it already produces identities.
doesNotFire: A wagon that declares no theme.
Questions of runtime module ownership, agent roles, or domain vocabulary — this rule only checks namespace prefixes.
URNs the wagon consumes but does not produce.

given: A wagon declares a theme and produces artifacts, contracts, or telemetry identities (newly authored or already existing, declared in any location).
when: The planner authors, edits, validates, or reviews that wagon or any of its produced identities; theme or URN edits are examples, not the only trigger.
then: Make the leading theme segment of every produced artifact, contract, and telemetry URN equal the wagon's declared theme.
avoid: Reusing another theme's prefix for a produced URN because the artifact feels related to that domain.
Treating this namespace check as a statement about runtime module ownership, agent roles, or domain vocabulary.
Changing the wagon's theme just to make a mismatched URN pass instead of fixing the URN namespace.
unless: The wagon declares no theme: it is not subject to this cross-field predicate.
why: The theme token namespaces produced URNs; this is namespace consistency only, so a mismatched prefix breaks the identity namespace without implying anything about ownership, roles, or vocabulary.
evidence: Static validator (planner.static.validators.bun) reports no themed wagon whose produced artifact, contract, or telemetry URN theme prefix differs from the wagon theme.
Reviewer can compare the wagon's theme field with the first theme segment of each produced URN.
verifier_detail: urn_theme_prefix: the leading theme segment of a produced URN, which must equal the wagon theme.

Applies to produced artifact, contract, and telemetry identity URNs only, wherever declared; wagons with no declared theme are skipped. Checks all themed wagons, not only those touched by the current change; a differing prefix is the reported violation.
